definition: Śiva's autonomy-power (svasvātantryaśakti), by which he is conscious of himself. Synonymous with Śakti = I-consciousness. Not a physical vibration but a movement in the space of Consciousness. The Power of Śiva by which He manifests, maintains, and withdraws the entire universe.

sources.claim: spanda = Śiva's autonomy-power (svasvātantryaśakti), synonymous with Śakti (I-consciousness).

translations.note: Spanda is not physical vibration but a movement in the space of Consciousness. Śiva is without movement, but something moves in Him — that is Spanda. (sanskrit-trikashaivism.com)
